name: hud_ui_slider_border_set_bounds
description: HudUiSliderBorder::SetBounds stores the slider border origin, half-width, and height, then rebuilds the 13-point outline polyline.
known_limits: tier S verification remains deferred to the HudUiPolyline/HudUiSliderBorder source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4b4810 validates storing originX, originY, halfWidth, and height, then calling HudUiPolyline::SetPoint for indices 0 through 12 with the recovered outline coordinates.

Native smoke zhud_polyline_and_slider_border_constructor_smoke verifies SetBounds(10, 20, 3, 8) updates the stored bounds, keeps pointCount 13, moves the base origin to the first point, and writes the expected 13 outline points.
